title: The Best DSA Problems — A Curated Best-of Across Every Platform
tagline: A hand-picked best-of: the single highest-leverage problems from LeetCode, Blind 75, NeetCode, HackerRank, and HackerEarth — every one already has a full walkthrough here.
description:
There are thousands of practice problems and most of them teach the same handful of ideas. This sheet is the opposite of grinding: a tightly curated best-of where every problem either defines a reusable pattern or shows up constantly in real interview loops. It is drawn from the strongest entries across Blind 75, NeetCode 150, the LeetCode Top Interview 150, and the HackerRank Interview Prep Kit.

Every problem on this list already has a complete InterviewExplainer walkthrough — clarifying questions, brute-force → optimal, dry-run trace, and line-by-line Java and Python — so there are no "Queued" gaps to slow you down.
credit: Curated by InterviewExplainer from the best entries across every major sheet.
howToUse: Start with The 12 Non-Negotiables — if any feel shaky, that is your week-one plan.
For each problem, attempt for 20 minutes, then read the walkthrough and re-solve from scratch.
Say the optimal approach out loud in interview voice before moving on.
Mix difficulties: pair one Hard with two Mediums per session to build stamina.
Come back to this sheet the week before any onsite as a fast, high-confidence refresher.
whyThisSheet: Maximum interview-readiness per hour — no filler, every problem earns its slot.
Drawn from the best of Blind 75, NeetCode 150, LeetCode 150, and HackerRank.
